extracted.intended_audience: public relations professionals, PR teams at companies, and small-business owners creating video news releases (VNRs)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical best-practices for producing and distributing Video News Releases (VNRs) so broadcast news outlets will use the footage; covers story selection, production style, technical delivery, pitching timing, and tracking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on newsworthiness
rubrics_metrics.description: Make sure there is a legitimate news story at the heart of your VNR; avoid a blatantly promotional tone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: VNRs are looked down on as propaganda when overly promotional. News stations can 'smell a pretender a mile away,' so prioritize supplying useful story content to the media rather than overt self-promotion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forget about effects / provide raw, editable footage
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid unique formatting and special effects; deliver raw footage that news outlets can easily edit into a news story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Save special effects for home videos. Keep your VNR at 5-7 minutes of clean and simple footage, and make sure it follows a coherent script. The real value for news outlets is editable, straightforward footage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organize your satellite feed / technical delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the technical delivery of the VNR is arranged (typically via C-band satellite) and the release date is timed appropriately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Your production company should handle technical aspects and receives feed specifications when purchasing satellite time. Your direct responsibilities: make sure satellite time has been purchased on the C-band satellites most stations use, and confirm the scheduled release date(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Actively pitch on release day
rubrics_metrics.description: Execute targeted PR pitches and media alerts on the day the VNR is released to maximize pickup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timing is everything — do not send pitches the day before the VNR and definitely don't wait until the day after. Your PR team should pull the trigger on pitches and send media alerts to targeted stations when the feed goes out.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track usage via encoding and tracking tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitor how stations use your VNR and estimate viewership by encoding and tracking the video before delivery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sigma encoding before the satellite feed, combined with other video tracking tools, lets you monitor usage and estimate the number of people who watched your VNR. Use these metrics to tweak future VNR campaigns.
